title: [review] local-fact: bind issuer kid to verifying pubkey in verify_local_fact
description: Correctness finding on viku.4. verify_local_fact never checks that the unprotected-header issuer_iid corresponds to the verifying gateway_pubkey (issuer_iid is not signature-covered). Sibling verify_delegation_token rejects DELEGATOR_IID_MISMATCH via _pubkey_to_iid. Not a forgery vector when callers resolve keys strictly by kid (signature dominates), but a hygiene downgrade vs the sibling and matters if downstream trusts issuer_iid for federation/audit. Fix: add _pubkey_to_iid(gateway_pubkey) == fact.issuer_iid check.
close_reason: verify_local_fact now rejects when _pubkey_to_iid(gateway_pubkey) != fact.issuer_iid (issuer_iid is unprotected, not signature-covered), matching sibling verify_delegation_token's DELEGATOR_IID_MISMATCH hygiene; the check fires before the signature verify. Added test_verify_rejects_issuer_iid_mismatch covering wrong-pubkey and spoofed-kid (attackers IID in unprotected header with A's valid payload signature). Non-vacuous: independently confirmed the spoofed fact's payload signature is cryptographically valid, so the IID binding is the sole rejector. 36 local_facts + 379 gateway tests pass. Self-reviewed (reviewer API intermittently timing out): correct/sibling-consistent, closes unprotected-kid spoof for federation/audit consumers, no regression to existing roundtrips.
